dimensions.assessment: Affects regional populations, county marine resources committees, and tribal governments in the Northwest Straits region of Washington state.
Continues advisory commission operations, technical support, and marine conservation projects.
Authorizes $3,000,000 annually for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2031.
dimensions.evidence: there are authorized to be appropriated to the Under Secretary $3,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2031 to carry out this title.

dimensions.assessment: Updates the structure, membership, and duties of the advisory commission without granting regulatory authority.
dimensions.evidence: Nothing in this title provides the Commission with authority to issue regulations or implement any Federal law or regulation.

dimensions.assessment: Provides a six-year reauthorization spanning fiscal years 2026 through 2031.
